card.title: Disaster Mesh: works when the internet doesn't.
card.fine: Real Android app (TW Mesh, GPL-3.0 fork of SafeMesh / bitchat). Three emulators, real ENS names on Sepolia, real Arkiv writes. Shaking = labelled test signal.

pieces.vo: Disaster Mesh. When the internet is gone, the phones of a Tremor Witness site keep working together.
pieces.cap: Disaster Mesh: when the internet is gone, a site's phones keep working together.

pieces.vo: Three phones, each registered on E N S at one site. Wi-Fi and mobile data are off. They find each other over Bluetooth.
pieces.cap: 3 phones, each registered on ENS at one site. Wi-Fi and data off: they connect over Bluetooth.

pieces.vo: For this demo, each phone sends a test shaking signal. Real detection needs strong shaking, about ninety-six millimetres per second.
pieces.cap: Demo: a labelled TEST shaking signal on each phone. Real detection: ≥ 96 mm/s (intensity VI).

pieces.vo: Every phone runs the same quorum rule as the dashboard: three registered phones within two seconds. Disaster confirmed, on every phone, with no server.
pieces.cap: Same quorum rule as the dashboard: 3 registered phones within 2 s → DISASTER CONFIRMED. No server.

pieces.vo: Phone B needs help, and adds a note. Phone A is safe. Every message is signed by the phone's own key, and only registered phones count.
pieces.cap: B: “I need help · flat 302”. A: “I'm safe”. Signed by each phone; only registered phones count.

pieces.vo: Each phone lists who has not been heard from, straight from the registry. No G P S.
pieces.cap: “Not heard from” = the ENS roster minus check-ins. No GPS.

pieces.vo: Phone A gets internet back. It writes its own check-in to Arkiv. The test signals never leave the phone.
pieces.cap: A is back online → writes its OWN check-in to Arkiv. Test signals are never uploaded.

pieces.vo: Read back with the Tremor Witness code: the creator is phone A, and it points to the confirmed alert.
pieces.cap: Read back with Tremor Witness's own fetchCheckins: creator = phone A, armMs = the confirmed alert.

card.title: github.com/Mulaydm10/tremor-witness-mesh
card.fine: Real: the app, the Bluetooth mesh, ENS names on Sepolia, Arkiv writes. Simulated: the shaking (test signal) and the phones (emulators).

pieces.vo: Same phones, same keys, same quorum rule. It keeps working when the servers and the internet are gone.
pieces.cap: Same phones, same keys, same quorum rule. Works when the servers and the internet are gone.
